---
title: Design Tokens
description: Configuration and usage of design tokens in Rimelight UI.
---

Rimelight UI provides a set of design tokens to establish a consistent visual language across your application.

## Core Tokens

- **Spacing**: Fluid spacing tokens from `6xs` to `6xl` that adapt to viewport size.
- **Radius**: Custom border-radius modifiers based on the core `--radius` token.
- **Typography**: Predefined sans, serif, and mono font family configurations.
